items.title: Claude Code's "Don't Ask Again" exposes passwords in 1,122 public GitHub files
items.summary: A discussion reveals that Claude Code's "Don't Ask Again" feature unintentionally leaked passwords in over a thousand public GitHub repositories. The issue stems from the model caching secret strings and reusing them across prompts.
items.why_it_matters: It shows a concrete supply‑chain secret‑leak risk in a popular coding agent that many engineers run locally or via API.
items.next_step_detail: Upgrade to the latest Claude SDK version that disables the cache or add a post‑processing filter to scrub secrets from model outputs.

items.title: ranxianglei / billion-context

items.next_step_detail: Install via `npm i billion-context` and test with your LLM inference server.

items.title: You tried git-lrc. Meet LiveReview 👀
items.summary: LiveReview is a risk-aware AI code review system that assigns a risk score to pull requests using LLM analysis, a custom ML model trained on organizational incidents, and graph-based static analysis. It automatically approves the lowest-risk 30-50% of PRs and routes the remainder to human reviewers sorted by risk level.
items.why_it_matters: It reduces the senior engineer bottleneck by auto-approving safe changes and prioritizing high-risk diffs, aiming to decrease production incidents and rollbacks.
items.next_step_detail: Run `pip install livereview` and enable it in your repo’s CI config.

items.title: Every Mac comes with an (undocumented) family member classifier
items.summary: macOS 13 and later include daemons that construct a local, plaintext SQLite knowledge graph of user contacts, relationships, and activities. This system cross-references data from Contacts, Calendar, Photos, Messages, Mail, and location to create a queryable store for LLMs.
items.why_it_matters: The graph is stored in plaintext within a TCC-protected directory, creating a single point of failure that could be exploited to threaten users if the data is compromised.
items.next_step_detail: Read the post and consider disabling the daemons on build machines.

items.title: Show HN: Coldframe, a honeypot that poses as a supermarket fridge controller
items.summary: Coldframe is a single-file Python honeypot that emulates Danfoss and Dixell supermarket refrigeration controllers to log attacker credentials, exploits, and actions without exposing real systems. It replicates specific vendor behaviors, such as TLS configurations and login flows, to appear authentic to scanners and malicious actors.
items.why_it_matters: It provides a lightweight, dependency-free tool for capturing telemetry on specific CVEs and default credential attacks targeting industrial refrigeration infrastructure.
items.next_step_detail: Clone the repo and run the Docker compose example to see the fake controller in action.
items.verification_note: Coldframe provides a lightweight, dependency-free tool for capturing telemetry on specific CVEs and default credential attacks targeting industrial refrigeration infrastructure

items.title: meta / astryx
items.summary: Astryx is an open-source React 19+ design system featuring 150+ accessible components, brand-level theming, and a CLI designed for use by both humans and AI agents. It utilizes StyleX for styling but allows overrides via standard CSS methods, requiring no build plugins or specific styling libraries.
items.why_it_matters: The API, documentation, and CLI are designed so that AI assistants and humans build using the same reference and tooling, enabling consistent component creation across both workflows.
items.next_step_detail: Browse the README to understand its agent integration points.

items.title: jamiepine / voicebox
items.summary: Voicebox is a local-first, open-source AI voice studio that clones voices, generates speech across 23 languages using eight TTS engines, and dictates into any application. It provides a REST API and MCP server to integrate voice input and output into autonomous agents.
items.why_it_matters: It offers a complete, locally running voice I/O stack with an API-first design, allowing developers to add voice capabilities to agents without relying on cloud services.
items.next_step_detail: Review the README to see integration points with your Python agent stack.
